=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/codex_model_catalog.json:445-662 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The PR sets `apply_patch_tool_type` back from "function" to "freeform" for the default editor slug openai/gpt-6-sol and for every OpenAI editor and fallback slug (also scripts/codex_model_catalog_overrides.yaml line 10). The repo's own record names "freeform" on the OpenRouter Responses path as the root cause of the openai/codex#11151 failure where the model announces an edit but never emits one.
  WHY: The PR has no live evidence or smoke run showing that patch-heavy turns still emit edits under v0.171.0 with "freeform". The pre-push gate is "unverified", and the new test_catalog_entries_parse_on_codex_v0171 only proves that the catalog parses. If #11151 comes back, implement, editor, heal and conflict-resolver turns would end with no edits and burn retries.
- agents.md:3216-3230, 5482-5487 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: agents.md still gives guidance that this PR made false, which contradicts agents.d/10129-codex-v0171-pin.md and the edited catalog. Line 5482 says keep "function" as the settled baseline, line 5487 says keep `include_apply_patch_tool = true` and function-style patch wiring, lines 3229-3230 say the gpt-5.4 entry is `function`, and lines 3216-3217 call include_apply_patch_tool the primary belt-and-suspenders.
  WHY: Pipeline agents ingest agents.md and may write "function" back into the catalog, which no longer parses on v0.171.0. test_catalog_entries_parse_on_codex_v0171 would catch that only after a wasted run, and §25 allows a direct edit to correct existing text. Severity disagreement: sonnet and gemini rated it MAJOR, luna and glm rated it NIT; the highest is used.
- README.md:99 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The WORKFLOW_EDITOR_MODEL row still says the catalog was "(now flipped to `function` in `scripts/codex_model_catalog.json`)", but every entry is now "freeform". It also contradicts docs/codex-model-reference.md:26.
  WHY: This is documentation drift only, but it misleads operators who tune the override about which patch-tool type is in effect.
- scripts/write_codex_config.sh:250-262 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The config writer still emits `printf 'include_apply_patch_tool = true\n'` and its comment calls the key the active #11151 mitigation, but the PR's own fragment says v0.171.0 ignores the key with a warning.
  WHY: Every codex exec run now logs an ignored-key warning, and maintainers are pointed at a mitigation that has no effect, which matters if the freeform regression comes back.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:33 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The stale note "`apply_patch_tool_type: freeform → function` for OpenAI slugs" still describes the `function` flip as the resolution and does not mention the v0.171.0 reversal.
  WHY: The comment drifts from the shipped catalog, the same class of correction the PR applied to codex_model_catalog_overrides.yaml and docs/codex-model-reference.md; no code fails.
- README.md:3224-3236 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Inside the "Historical Phase 1 rollout snapshot retained for integration fingerprint verification" block, the PR replaces `v0.114.0` with `v0.171.0` at lines 3226 and 3231 but leaves OPENCODE_VERSION at `1.18.23`, a selective rewrite of the historical fingerprint.
  WHY: Any future fingerprint check against this snapshot would find a false mismatch on CODEX_VERSION. This is doc or contract drift, not a runtime crash.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The PR diff replaces v0.114.0 with v0.171.0 at README.md:3226 and README.md:3231 inside the historical snapshot. The neighbouring OPENCODE_VERSION row (1.18.23) was preserved, so the rewrite was selective. The parallel agents.md:3190 snapshot is untouched, so the two copies diverge. Counterweight from glm: scope item 4 authorises README pin updates and README is not on the issue's historical-docs list. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 explicitly rejected this gap.

  expected_change_site: agents.md lessons at lines 3216-3217, 3228-3230, 5482, 5486-5487
  confidence=5

- requirement: "Check, and fix whatever v0.171.0 changed ... the `codex exec` flags and `-c` keys the pipelines pass (... `include_apply_patch_tool` ...)" (issue #10129 scope item 2)
  expected_change_site: scripts/write_codex_config.sh (`printf 'include_apply_patch_tool = true\n'`) and every `-c include_apply_patch_tool=...` call site
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: scripts/write_codex_config.sh still emits the key unconditionally and its 251-262 comment calls it the active mitigation. The `-c include_apply_patch_tool=...` sites were not removed, and scripts/targeted_file_context.py:33 carries the same stale `freeform → function` note.
- requirement: "README mentions of the pinned version" stay accurate (issue #10129 scope item 4)
  expected_change_site: README.md line 99
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The PR diff replaces every `function` entry with `freeform`, but the README line 99 narrative still says "now flipped to `function` in `scripts/codex_model_catalog.json`".

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
